perks.name: Cluster Bomb
perks.description: Rockets spawn cluster bombs upon detonation.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

perks.name: Envious Assassin
perks.description: Defeating targets with other weapons before drawing this one transfers ammo to the magazine from reserves. This effect can overflow the magazine based on the number of targets defeated.

perks.name: Keep Away
perks.description: Increases reload, range, and accuracy when no targets are in close proximity.

perks.name: Pulse Monitor
perks.description: Automatically reloads the magazine and improves weapon handling when wounded—even when this weapon is stowed.

perks.name: Field Prep
perks.description: Increases ammo generation. Faster reload, stow, and ready speed when you're crouching.

perks.name: Destabilizing Rounds
perks.description: Defeating a target creates a Void burst; hitting other targets with this burst makes them volatile and grants you Volatile Rounds for a short duration.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

perks.name: Golden Tricorn
perks.description: Final blows with this weapon grant bonus damage. While this buff is active, grenade or melee kills of the same damage type greatly increase its damage and duration.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Frenzy
perks.description: Being in combat for an extended time increases damage, handling, and reload for this weapon until you are out of combat.

perks.name: Lasting Impression
perks.description: Rockets attach on impact and detonate after a delay. Increases blast radius and damage.
